title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Returned-Payment Fee and Certified-Funds Restriction Schedule
content:
**Schedule of returned-item terms, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** The four figures below are the same on Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+.

| Figure | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Company returned-payment fee, before the state maximum recorded on the contract is applied | 25.00 USD |
| Returned payments within the lookback that trigger the certified-funds restriction | 2 |
| Lookback for counting returned payments | 12 calendar months |
| Length of a certified-funds-only restriction | 6 calendar months |

## How the figures are read

- The fee actually assessed is the lower of the 25.00 dollar company fee and the state maximum recorded on the contract; where that state maximum is 0.00, the lower figure is 0.00.
- The restriction trigger is reached when the count of returned payments in the 12-month lookback reaches 2; one returned payment in the lookback does not reach it.
- A restriction runs until the date 6 calendar months after the latest return date.

*Hypothetical illustration:* on a contract whose recorded state maximum returned-payment fee is 15.00 dollars, the fee assessed is 15.00 dollars, the lower of 25.00 and 15.00; on a contract whose recorded state maximum is 40.00 dollars, it is 25.00 dollars.
